∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) {n : NumberField.InfinitePlace ℚ → ℤ} {t : NumberField.InfinitePlace ℚ → ℂ},
  χ.IsArchimedeanParameter Rat.infinitePlace (n Rat.infinitePlace) (t Rat.infinitePlace) →
    ∀ (N : ℕ) (hN : Langlands.HeckeRat.level χ = N) [inst : NeZero N] {s : ℂ},
      1 < (s + t Rat.infinitePlace).re →
        χ.completedLFunction n t s =
          DirichletCharacter.completedLFunction (Langlands.HeckeRat.psi χ N hN) (s + t Rat.infinitePlace)

Langlands.HeckeRat.exists_approx.type:
∀ (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ))
  (u : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion ℚ v),
  Valued.v u ≤ 1 →
    ∀ (k : ℕ),
      ∃ b,
        Valued.v
            ((algebraMap ℚ (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion ℚ v))
                ((algebraMap (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ) ℚ) b) -
              u) ≤
          WithZero.exp (-↑k)

Langlands.HeckeRat.exists_approx_crt.type:
∀ (S : Finset (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)))

    (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)) →
      IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion ℚ v),
  (∀ v ∈ S, Valued.v (u v) ≤ 1) →
    ∀ (k : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ) → ℕ),
      ∃ b,
        ∀ v ∈ S,
          Valued.v ((algebraMap ℚ (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion ℚ v)) ↑b - u v) ≤
            WithZero.exp (-↑(k v))

Langlands.HeckeRat.exists_good_H.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) {w : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)},
  w ∈ Langlands.HeckeRat.ram χ →
    ∀ (u : (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion ℚ w)ˣ),
      Valued.v ↑u = 1 →
        ∃ b,
          Langlands.HeckeRat.Good χ b ∧
            Langlands.HeckeRat.H χ ↑b = (χ.finiteComponent w) u ∧
              Valued.v ((algebraMap ℚ (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion ℚ w)) ↑b - ↑u) ≤
                  WithZero.exp (-↑(χ.conductorExponent w)) ∧
                ∀ v ∈ Langlands.HeckeRat.ram χ,
                  v ≠ w →
                    Valued.v ((algebraMap ℚ (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion ℚ v)) ↑b - 1) ≤
                      WithZero.exp (-↑(χ.conductorExponent v))

Langlands.HeckeRat.exists_rat_val.type:

      Valued.v ((algebraMap ℚ (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion ℚ v)) ↑q) =
        Valued.v ↑((Langlands.HeckeRat.compFin v) x)

Langlands.HeckeRat.exists_trivOn.type: ∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ), ∃ m S, Langlands.HeckeRat.TrivOn χ m ∧ ∀ v ∉ S, m v = 0

      Valued.v
          ↑((Langlands.HeckeRat.compFin v)
              (((NumberField.IdeleGroup.unitEmbedding (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ) ℚ) q)⁻¹ * x)) =
        1

Langlands.HeckeRat.ext_idele.type:
∀ {x y : NumberField.IdeleGroup (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ) ℚ},
  Langlands.HeckeRat.compInf x = Langlands.HeckeRat.compInf y →
    (∀ (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)),
        (Langlands.HeckeRat.compFin v) x = (Langlands.HeckeRat.compFin v) y) →
      x = y

Langlands.HeckeRat.finiteComponent_loc_c.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) {w : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)}
  {x y : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion ℚ w},
  Valued.v x = 1 →
    Valued.v y = 1 →
      Valued.v (y - x) ≤ WithZero.exp (-↑(χ.conductorExponent w)) →
        (χ.finiteComponent w) (Langlands.HeckeRat.loc w y) = (χ.finiteComponent w) (Langlands.HeckeRat.loc w x)

Langlands.HeckeRat.finiteComponent_local.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) {n : ℤ} {t : ℂ},
  χ.IsArchimedeanParameter Rat.infinitePlace n t →
    ∀ {w : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)},
      w ∉ Langlands.HeckeRat.ram χ →
        ↑((χ.finiteComponent w) (Langlands.localUniformizer ℚ w)) =
          (Langlands.HeckeRat.psi χ (Langlands.HeckeRat.level χ) ⋯) ↑(Langlands.HeckeRat.pr w) *
            ↑(Langlands.HeckeRat.pr w) ^ (-t)

Langlands.HeckeRat.finiteComponent_pr_mu.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) {w : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)},
  w ∉ Langlands.HeckeRat.ram χ →
    (χ.finiteComponent w)
          (Langlands.HeckeRat.loc w
            ((algebraMap ℚ (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion ℚ w)) ↑(Langlands.HeckeRat.pr w))) *
        ((χ.infiniteComponent Rat.infinitePlace)
            (Langlands.HeckeRat.compInf
              ((NumberField.IdeleGroup.unitEmbedding (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ) ℚ)
                (Units.mk0 ↑(Langlands.HeckeRat.pr w) ⋯))) *
          Langlands.HeckeRat.H χ ↑(Langlands.HeckeRat.pr w)) =
      1

Langlands.HeckeRat.finiteComponent_unifo.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) {w : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)},
  w ∉ Langlands.HeckeRat.ram χ →
    (χ.finiteComponent w) (Langlands.localUniformizer ℚ w) =
      (χ.finiteComponent w)
        (Langlands.HeckeRat.loc w
          ((algebraMap ℚ (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion ℚ w)) ↑(Langlands.HeckeRat.pr w)))

Langlands.HeckeRat.finiteLFunction_eq.type:
∀ {χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ} {n : ℤ} {t : ℂ},
  χ.IsArchimedeanParameter Rat.infinitePlace n t →
    ∀ {s : ℂ},
      1 < (s + t).re →
        χ.finiteLFunction s = LSeries (fun k => (Langlands.HeckeRat.psi χ (Langlands.HeckeRat.level χ) ⋯) ↑k) (s + t)

Langlands.HeckeRat.gammaFactor_eq.type:
∀ {χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ} {n : NumberField.InfinitePlace ℚ → ℤ} {t : NumberField.InfinitePlace ℚ → ℂ},
  χ.IsArchimedeanParameter Rat.infinitePlace (n Rat.infinitePlace) (t Rat.infinitePlace) →
    ∀ (s : ℂ),
      Langlands.gammaFactor ℚ n t s =
        (Langlands.HeckeRat.psi χ (Langlands.HeckeRat.level χ) ⋯).gammaFactor (s + t Rat.infinitePlace)

Langlands.HeckeRat.good_congr.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) {b b' : ℤ},
  Langlands.HeckeRat.Good χ b → ↑(Langlands.HeckeRat.level χ) ∣ b' - b → Langlands.HeckeRat.Good χ b'

Langlands.HeckeRat.good_iff_coprime.type: ∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) (n : ℕ), Langlands.HeckeRat.Good χ ↑n ↔ n.Coprime (Langlands.HeckeRat.level χ)

Langlands.HeckeRat.good_mul.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) {b c : ℤ},
  Langlands.HeckeRat.Good χ b → Langlands.HeckeRat.Good χ c → Langlands.HeckeRat.Good χ (b * c)

Langlands.HeckeRat.good_pr.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) {w : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)},
  w ∉ Langlands.HeckeRat.ram χ → Langlands.HeckeRat.Good χ ↑(Langlands.HeckeRat.pr w)

Langlands.HeckeRat.good_zmod_val.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) (x : ZMod (Langlands.HeckeRat.level χ)) {b : ℤ},
  ↑b = x → Langlands.HeckeRat.Good χ b → Langlands.HeckeRat.Good χ ↑x.val

Langlands.HeckeRat.ideleNorm_decomp.type:
∀ (q : ℚˣ) (x : NumberField.IdeleGroup (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ) ℚ),
  Langlands.ideleNorm ℚ (((NumberField.IdeleGroup.unitEmbedding (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ) ℚ) q)⁻¹ * x) =
    Langlands.ideleNorm ℚ x

Langlands.HeckeRat.ideleNorm_mul.type:
∀ (a b : NumberField.IdeleGroup (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ) ℚ),
  Langlands.ideleNorm ℚ (a * b) = Langlands.ideleNorm ℚ a * Langlands.ideleNorm ℚ b

Langlands.HeckeRat.ideleNorm_of_units.type:
∀ (y : NumberField.IdeleGroup (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ) ℚ),
  (∀ (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)),
      Valued.v ↑((Langlands.HeckeRat.compFin v) y) = 1) →
    Langlands.ideleNorm ℚ y = ‖↑(Langlands.HeckeRat.compInf y)‖

Langlands.HeckeRat.ideleNorm_unitEmbeddi.type: ∀ (q : ℚˣ), Langlands.ideleNorm ℚ ((NumberField.IdeleGroup.unitEmbedding (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ) ℚ) q) = 1

Langlands.HeckeRat.infiniteComponent_of_.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) {n : ℤ} {t : ℂ},
  χ.IsArchimedeanParameter Rat.infinitePlace n t →
    ∀ (a : ℝ) (z : Rat.infinitePlace.Completionˣ),
      (NumberField.InfinitePlace.Completion.extensionEmbedding Rat.infinitePlace) ↑z = ↑(Real.exp a) →
        ↑((χ.infiniteComponent Rat.infinitePlace) z) = Complex.exp (↑a * t)

Langlands.HeckeRat.infiniteComponent_rat.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) {n : ℤ} {t : ℂ},
  χ.IsArchimedeanParameter Rat.infinitePlace n t →
    ∀ (q : ℚˣ),
      ↑((χ.infiniteComponent Rat.infinitePlace)
            (Langlands.HeckeRat.compInf ((NumberField.IdeleGroup.unitEmbedding (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ) ℚ) q))) =
        (↑↑q / ↑|↑↑q|) ^ n * ↑|↑↑q| ^ t

Langlands.HeckeRat.intCast_mem_asIdeal_p.type:
∀ (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)) (z : ℤ) (k : ℕ),
  ↑z ∈ v.asIdeal ^ k ↔ ↑(Langlands.HeckeRat.pr v) ^ k ∣ z

Langlands.HeckeRat.isCoprime_of_good.type: ∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) {b : ℤ}, Langlands.HeckeRat.Good χ b → IsCoprime b ↑(Langlands.HeckeRat.level χ)

Langlands.HeckeRat.isTrivial_cond.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)),
  χ.IsTrivialOnHigherUnits v (χ.conductorExponent v)

Langlands.HeckeRat.isTrivial_mono.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) {v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)} {a b : ℕ},
  a ≤ b → χ.IsTrivialOnHigherUnits v a → χ.IsTrivialOnHigherUnits v b

Langlands.HeckeRat.isUnit_of_good.type: ∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) {b : ℤ}, Langlands.HeckeRat.Good χ b → IsUnit ↑b

Langlands.HeckeRat.isUnramifiedAt_iff.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)),
  χ.IsUnramifiedAt v ↔ v ∉ Langlands.HeckeRat.ram χ

Langlands.HeckeRat.key.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) {m : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ) → ℕ},
  Langlands.HeckeRat.TrivOn χ m →
    ∀ (S : Finset (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ))),
      (∀ v ∉ S, m v = 0) →
        ∀ (x : NumberField.IdeleGroup (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ) ℚ),
          (∀ (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)),
              Valued.v ↑((Langlands.HeckeRat.compFin v) x) = 1) →
            (Langlands.HeckeRat.chiI χ) x =
              (χ.infiniteComponent Rat.infinitePlace) (Langlands.HeckeRat.compInf x) *
                ∏ v ∈ S, (χ.finiteComponent v) ((Langlands.HeckeRat.compFin v) x)

Langlands.HeckeRat.key_ram.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) (x : NumberField.IdeleGroup (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ) ℚ),
  (∀ (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)),
      Valued.v ↑((Langlands.HeckeRat.compFin v) x) = 1) →
    (Langlands.HeckeRat.chiI χ) x =
      (χ.infiniteComponent Rat.infinitePlace) (Langlands.HeckeRat.compInf x) *
        ∏ v ∈ Langlands.HeckeRat.ram χ, (χ.finiteComponent v) ((Langlands.HeckeRat.compFin v) x)

Langlands.HeckeRat.level_dvd.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) {z : ℤ},
  (∀ v ∈ Langlands.HeckeRat.ram χ, ↑(Langlands.HeckeRat.pr v) ^ χ.conductorExponent v ∣ z) →
    ↑(Langlands.HeckeRat.level χ) ∣ z

Langlands.HeckeRat.level_inv.type: ∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ), Langlands.HeckeRat.level χ⁻¹ = Langlands.HeckeRat.level χ

Langlands.HeckeRat.loc.type:
(v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)) →
  IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion ℚ v → (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion ℚ v)ˣ

Langlands.HeckeRat.localFactor_eq.type:
∀ {χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ} {n : ℤ} {t : ℂ},
  χ.IsArchimedeanParameter Rat.infinitePlace n t →
    ∀ (w : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)) (s : ℂ),
      χ.localFactor w s =
        (1 -
            (Langlands.HeckeRat.psi χ (Langlands.HeckeRat.level χ) ⋯) ↑(Langlands.HeckeRat.pr w) *
              ↑(Langlands.HeckeRat.pr w) ^ (-(s + t)))⁻¹

Langlands.HeckeRat.mem_ram.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) {v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)},
  v ∈ Langlands.HeckeRat.ram χ ↔ χ.conductorExponent v ≠ 0

Langlands.HeckeRat.n_eq_zero_of_level_on.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) {n : ℤ} {t : ℂ},
  χ.IsArchimedeanParameter Rat.infinitePlace n t → Langlands.HeckeRat.level χ = 1 → n = 0

Langlands.HeckeRat.ne_zero_of_val_eq_one.type:
∀ {v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)}
  {x : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion ℚ v}, Valued.v x = 1 → x ≠ 0

Langlands.HeckeRat.norm_chi.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) {n : ℤ} {t : ℂ},
  χ.IsArchimedeanParameter Rat.infinitePlace n t →
    ∀ (x : NumberField.IdeleGroup (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ) ℚ), ‖↑(χ ↑x)‖ = Langlands.ideleNorm ℚ x ^ t.re

Langlands.HeckeRat.norm_finiteComponent_.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) (w : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ))
  (u : (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion ℚ w)ˣ), Valued.v ↑u = 1 → ‖↑((χ.finiteComponent w) u)‖ = 1

Langlands.HeckeRat.norm_infiniteComponen.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) {n : ℤ} {t : ℂ},
  χ.IsArchimedeanParameter Rat.infinitePlace n t →
    ∀ (z : Rat.infinitePlace.Completionˣ), ‖↑((χ.infiniteComponent Rat.infinitePlace) z)‖ = ‖↑z‖ ^ t.re

Langlands.HeckeRat.not_good_pr.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) {w : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)},
  w ∈ Langlands.HeckeRat.ram χ → ¬Langlands.HeckeRat.Good χ ↑(Langlands.HeckeRat.pr w)

Langlands.HeckeRat.pow_dvd_level.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) {v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)},
  v ∈ Langlands.HeckeRat.ram χ → Langlands.HeckeRat.pr v ^ χ.conductorExponent v ∣ Langlands.HeckeRat.level χ

Langlands.HeckeRat.pr_dvd_level.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) {v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)},
  v ∈ Langlands.HeckeRat.ram χ → Langlands.HeckeRat.pr v ∣ Langlands.HeckeRat.level χ

Langlands.HeckeRat.prime_dvd_level.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) {p : ℕ},
  Nat.Prime p → p ∣ Langlands.HeckeRat.level χ → ∃ v ∈ Langlands.HeckeRat.ram χ, p = Langlands.HeckeRat.pr v

Langlands.HeckeRat.psi.type: (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) → (N : ℕ) → Langlands.HeckeRat.level χ = N → DirichletCharacter ℂ N

Langlands.HeckeRat.psi.congr_simp.type:
∀ (χ χ_1 : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) (e_χ : χ = χ_1) (N : ℕ) (hN : Langlands.HeckeRat.level χ = N),
  Langlands.HeckeRat.psi χ N hN = Langlands.HeckeRat.psi χ_1 N ⋯

Langlands.HeckeRat.psiHom.type: (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) → (N : ℕ) → Langlands.HeckeRat.level χ = N → (ZMod N)ˣ →* ℂˣ

Langlands.HeckeRat.psi_apply_int.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) {b : ℤ},
  Langlands.HeckeRat.Good χ b →
    (Langlands.HeckeRat.psi χ (Langlands.HeckeRat.level χ) ⋯) ↑b = ↑(Langlands.HeckeRat.H χ ↑b)⁻¹

Langlands.HeckeRat.psi_apply_nat.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) {n : ℕ},
  Langlands.HeckeRat.Good χ ↑n →
    (Langlands.HeckeRat.psi χ (Langlands.HeckeRat.level χ) ⋯) ↑n = ↑(Langlands.HeckeRat.H χ ↑n)⁻¹

Langlands.HeckeRat.psi_apply_nat_of_not_.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) {n : ℕ},
  ¬Langlands.HeckeRat.Good χ ↑n → (Langlands.HeckeRat.psi χ (Langlands.HeckeRat.level χ) ⋯) ↑n = 0

Langlands.HeckeRat.psi_apply_unit.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) (a : (ZMod (Langlands.HeckeRat.level χ))ˣ),
  (Langlands.HeckeRat.psi χ (Langlands.HeckeRat.level χ) ⋯) ↑a = ↑(Langlands.HeckeRat.H χ ↑↑(↑a).val)⁻¹

Langlands.HeckeRat.psi_inv.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) (N : ℕ) (hN : Langlands.HeckeRat.level χ = N)
  (hN' : Langlands.HeckeRat.level χ⁻¹ = N), Langlands.HeckeRat.psi χ⁻¹ N hN' = (Langlands.HeckeRat.psi χ N hN)⁻¹

Langlands.HeckeRat.psi_isPrimitive.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) (N : ℕ) (hN : Langlands.HeckeRat.level χ = N),

Langlands.HeckeRat.psi_neg_one.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) {n : ℤ} {t : ℂ},
  χ.IsArchimedeanParameter Rat.infinitePlace n t →
    (Langlands.HeckeRat.psi χ (Langlands.HeckeRat.level χ) ⋯) (-1) = (-1) ^ n

Langlands.HeckeRat.ram_eq_empty.type: ∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ), Langlands.HeckeRat.level χ = 1 → Langlands.HeckeRat.ram χ = ∅

Langlands.HeckeRat.ram_inv.type: ∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ), Langlands.HeckeRat.ram χ⁻¹ = Langlands.HeckeRat.ram χ

Langlands.HeckeRat.t_inv.type:
∀ {χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ} {n n' : ℤ} {t t' : ℂ},
  χ.IsArchimedeanParameter Rat.infinitePlace n t → χ⁻¹.IsArchimedeanParameter Rat.infinitePlace n' t' → t' = -t

Langlands.HeckeRat.trivOn_ofAdic.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) {m : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ) → ℕ},
  Langlands.HeckeRat.TrivOn χ m →
    ∀ (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)), χ.IsTrivialOnHigherUnits v (m v)

Langlands.HeckeRat.val_coe.type:
∀ (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)) (q : ℚ),
  Valued.v ((algebraMap ℚ (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion ℚ v)) q) =
    (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.valuation ℚ v) q

Langlands.HeckeRat.val_intCast_eq_one_if.type:
∀ (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)) (z : ℤ),
  Valued.v ((algebraMap ℚ (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion ℚ v)) ↑z) = 1 ↔
    ¬↑(Langlands.HeckeRat.pr v) ∣ z

Langlands.HeckeRat.val_intCast_le_iff.type:
∀ (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)) (z : ℤ) (k : ℕ),
  Valued.v ((algebraMap ℚ (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion ℚ v)) ↑z) ≤ WithZero.exp (-↑k) ↔
    ↑(Langlands.HeckeRat.pr v) ^ k ∣ z

Langlands.HeckeRat.val_le_one_of_eq_one.type:
∀ {v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)}
  {x : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion ℚ v}, Valued.v x = 1 → Valued.v x ≤ 1

Langlands.HeckeRat.val_neg_one.type:
∀ (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)),
  Valued.v ((algebraMap ℚ (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion ℚ v)) (-1)) = 1

Langlands.HeckeRat.val_of_good.type:
∀ (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter ℚ) {b : ℤ},
  Langlands.HeckeRat.Good χ b →
    ∀ {v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)},
      v ∈ Langlands.HeckeRat.ram χ →
        Valued.v ((algebraMap ℚ (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion ℚ v)) ↑b) = 1

Langlands.HeckeRat.val_prod_pr_zpow.type:
∀ (T : Finset (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)))
  (e : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ) → ℤ)
  (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)),
  (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.valuation ℚ v) (∏ w ∈ T, ↑(Langlands.HeckeRat.pr w) ^ (-e w)) =
    if v ∈ T then WithZero.exp (e v) else 1

Langlands.HeckeRat.val_sub_one_iff.type:
∀ (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)) (b : ℤ) (k : ℕ),
  Valued.v ((algebraMap ℚ (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion ℚ v)) ↑b - 1) ≤ WithZero.exp (-↑k) ↔
    ↑(Langlands.HeckeRat.pr v) ^ k ∣ b - 1

Langlands.HeckeRat.val_sub_one_le_one.type:
∀ {v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)}
  {x : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion ℚ v}, Valued.v x ≤ 1 → Valued.v (x - 1) ≤ 1

Langlands.HeckeRat.valuation_intCast.type:
∀ (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)) (z : ℤ),
  (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.valuation ℚ v) ↑z = v.intValuation ↑z

Langlands.HeckeRat.valuation_intCast_eq_.type:
∀ (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)) (z : ℤ),
  (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.valuation ℚ v) ↑z = 1 ↔ ¬↑(Langlands.HeckeRat.pr v) ∣ z

Langlands.HeckeRat.valuation_intCast_le_.type:
∀ (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)) (z : ℤ) (k : ℕ),
  (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.valuation ℚ v) ↑z ≤ WithZero.exp (-↑k) ↔ ↑(Langlands.HeckeRat.pr v) ^ k ∣ z

Langlands.HeckeRat.valuation_pr_of_ne.type:
∀ {v w : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)},
  w ≠ v → (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.valuation ℚ v) ↑(Langlands.HeckeRat.pr w) = 1

Langlands.HeckeRat.valuation_pr_self.type:
∀ (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ℚ)),
  (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.valuation ℚ v) ↑(Langlands.HeckeRat.pr v) = WithZero.exp (-1)

Langlands.IsArtinMap.frobenius.type:
∀ {K : Type u} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] {L : IntermediateField K (AlgebraicClosure K)}
  {art : NumberField.IdeleClassGroup (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K) K →* Gal(↥L/K)},
  Langlands.IsArtinMap K L art →
    ∀ (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K))
      (w : Ideal (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ↥L)) [inst_2 : w.IsMaximal],
      w.LiesOver v.asIdeal →
        Algebra.IsUnramifiedAt (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K) w →

Langlands.IsGSpLanglandsMap.principalSer.type:
∀ {K : Type u} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : ValuativeRel K] [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace K]
  [inst_3 : IsNonarchimedeanLocalField K] {art : Kˣ ≃ₜ* Langlands.WeilGroup.Ab K}
  {L : Langlands.IrrSmooth ↥(Langlands.gsp4 K) → Langlands.GSpLParam K},
  Langlands.IsGSpLanglandsMap K art L →
    ∀ (π : Langlands.IrrRep ↥(Langlands.gsp4 K)) (χ₁ χ₂ σ : Kˣ →* ℂˣ),
      Langlands.IsSmoothChar K χ₁ →
        Langlands.IsSmoothChar K χ₂ →
          Langlands.IsSmoothChar K σ →
            (↑π).HasHom (Langlands.gspPrincipalSeries K χ₁ χ₂ σ) →
              ∀ (φ₁ φ₂ φσ : Langlands.WeilGroup K →* ℂˣ),
                Langlands.CharCorrespond K art χ₁ φ₁ →
                  Langlands.CharCorrespond K art χ₂ φ₂ →
                    Langlands.CharCorrespond K art σ φσ →
                      ∃ φ,
                        Langlands.GSpLParam.mk φ = L (Langlands.IrrSmooth.mk π) ∧
                          (∀ (w : Langlands.WeilGroup K),
                              ↑(φ.toWD.r w) =
                                Matrix.diagonal
                                  ![↑(φσ w) * ↑(φ₁ w) * ↑(φ₂ w), ↑(φσ w) * ↑(φ₁ w), ↑(φσ w) * ↑(φ₂ w), ↑(φσ w)]) ∧
                            ((Langlands.gspPrincipalSeries K χ₁ χ₂ σ).IsIrreducible → φ.toWD.N = 0)

Langlands.Tate.IsClassType.apply_ofAdicC.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] {χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter K}
  (hχ : Langlands.Tate.IsClassType χ) (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)),
  χ
      ((NumberField.IdeleClassGroup.ofAdicCompletion (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K) K v)
        (Langlands.localUniformizer K v)) =
    (Langlands.Tate.classChar χ hχ) (ClassGroup.mk0 (Langlands.Tate.primeNZ v))

Langlands.Tate.IsClassType.completedLFun.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] {χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter K},
  Langlands.Tate.IsClassType χ →
    ∀ (φ : ClassGroup (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K) →* ℂˣ),
      (∀ (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)),
          φ (ClassGroup.mk0 (Langlands.Tate.primeNZ v)) = Langlands.Tate.primeValue χ v) →
        ∀ {n : NumberField.InfinitePlace K → ℤ} {t : NumberField.InfinitePlace K → ℂ},
          (∀ (v : NumberField.InfinitePlace K), χ.IsArchimedeanParameter v (n v) (t v)) →
            ∀ {s : ℂ},
              1 < s.re →
                χ.completedLFunction n t s =
                  2 ^ NumberField.InfinitePlace.nrComplexPlaces K * Langlands.Tate.gammaK K s *
                    Langlands.Tate.classCharL φ s

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] {χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter K}
  (hχ : Langlands.Tate.IsClassType χ),
  Langlands.Tate.classChar χ hχ ≠ 1 →
    ∀ {n : NumberField.InfinitePlace K → ℤ} {t : NumberField.InfinitePlace K → ℂ},
      (∀ (v : NumberField.InfinitePlace K), χ.IsArchimedeanParameter v (n v) (t v)) →
        ∀ {s : ℂ},
          1 < s.re →
            χ.completedLFunction n t s =
              2 ^ NumberField.InfinitePlace.nrComplexPlaces K * ↑√|↑(NumberField.discr K)| ^ (-s) *
                Langlands.Tate.classCharLambda (Langlands.Tate.classChar χ hχ) s

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] {χ ξ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter K} {s₀ : ℂ},
  Langlands.Tate.IsClassType χ →
    (∀ (x : NumberField.IdeleGroup (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K) K),
        ↑(ξ ↑x) = ↑(χ ↑x) * ↑(Langlands.ideleNorm K x) ^ s₀) →
      ∀ {n : NumberField.InfinitePlace K → ℤ} {t : NumberField.InfinitePlace K → ℂ},
        (∀ (v : NumberField.InfinitePlace K), ξ.IsArchimedeanParameter v (n v) (t v)) →

        (∃ x, ‖x‖ ≤ Langlands.Tate.NonArchimedean.q v ^ (d + 1) ∧ ψ x ≠ 1) →
          ∀ (s : ℂ),
            ‖↑(χ⁻¹ (Langlands.localUniformizer K v))‖ < Langlands.Tate.NonArchimedean.q v ^ (1 - s).re →
              Langlands.Tate.NonArchimedean.zetaIntegral v
                  (Langlands.Tate.NonArchimedean.fourier v ψ ((Metric.closedBall 0 1).indicator 1)) χ⁻¹ (1 - s) =
                Langlands.Tate.NonArchimedean.epsilonUnramified v χ d s *
                  Langlands.Tate.NonArchimedean.localFactor v χ⁻¹ (1 - s)

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K]
  (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K))
  {χ : (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion K v)ˣ →* ℂˣ} {b : ℕ},
  Langlands.Tate.NonArchimedean.IsTrivialOnHigherUnits v χ (b + 1) →
    ¬Langlands.Tate.NonArchimedean.IsTrivialOnHigherUnits v χ b →
      ∀ (ψ : AddChar (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion K v) ℂ) (d : ℤ),
        (∀ (x : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion K v),
            ‖x‖ ≤ Langlands.Tate.NonArchimedean.q v ^ d → ψ x = 1) →
          (∃ x, ‖x‖ ≤ Langlands.Tate.NonArchimedean.q v ^ (d + 1) ∧ ψ x ≠ 1) →
            ∀ {c : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion K v} (hc0 : c ≠ 0),
              ‖c‖ = Langlands.Tate.NonArchimedean.q v ^ (d + ↑(b + 1)) →
                ∀ (s : ℂ),
                  ‖↑(χ⁻¹ (Langlands.localUniformizer K v))‖ < Langlands.Tate.NonArchimedean.q v ^ (1 - s).re →
                    Langlands.Tate.NonArchimedean.zetaIntegral v
                        (Langlands.Tate.NonArchimedean.fourier v ψ
                          (Langlands.Tate.NonArchimedean.testFunction v (b + 1)))
                        χ⁻¹ (1 - s) =
                      Langlands.Tate.NonArchimedean.epsilonRamified v χ ψ hc0 s *
                        ↑((1 - (Langlands.Tate.NonArchimedean.q v)⁻¹)⁻¹ *
                            (Langlands.Tate.NonArchimedean.q v)⁻¹ ^ (b + 1))

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K]
  (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K))
  (χ : (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion K v)ˣ →* ℂˣ)
  (ψ : AddChar (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion K v) ℂ) (d : ℤ),
  (∀ (x : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion K v),
      ‖x‖ ≤ Langlands.Tate.NonArchimedean.q v ^ d → ψ x = 1) →
    (∃ x, ‖x‖ ≤ Langlands.Tate.NonArchimedean.q v ^ (d + 1) ∧ ψ x ≠ 1) →
      ∀ (a : ℕ) {c : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion K v},
        c ≠ 0 →
          ‖c‖ = Langlands.Tate.NonArchimedean.q v ^ (d + ↑a) →
            ∀ (s : ℂ),
              Langlands.Tate.NonArchimedean.zetaIntegral v
                  (fun x =>
                    Langlands.Tate.NonArchimedean.fourier v ψ (Langlands.Tate.NonArchimedean.testFunction v a) (c * x))
                  χ⁻¹ (1 - s) =
                ∫ (x : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion K v) in Metric.closedBall 0 1,
                  Langlands.Tate.NonArchimedean.ramifiedIntegrand v χ ψ a c s
                    x ∂Langlands.Tate.NonArchimedean.multHaar v

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K]
  (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K))
  (χ : (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion K v)ˣ →* ℂˣ),
  (∀ (u : (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion K v)ˣ), ‖↑u‖ = 1 → χ u = 1) →
    ∀ (s : ℂ),
      ‖↑(χ (Langlands.localUniformizer K v))‖ < Langlands.Tate.NonArchimedean.q v ^ s.re →
        Langlands.Tate.NonArchimedean.zetaIntegral v ((Metric.closedBall 0 1).indicator 1) χ s =
          Langlands.Tate.NonArchimedean.localFactor v χ s

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K]
  (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K))
  (χ : (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion K v)ˣ →* ℂˣ),
  (¬∀ (u : (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion K v)ˣ), ‖↑u‖ = 1 → χ u = 1) →
    ∀ (s : ℂ), Langlands.Tate.NonArchimedean.zetaIntegral v ((Metric.closedBall 0 1).indicator 1) χ s = 0

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K]
  (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K))
  {χ : (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion K v)ˣ →* ℂˣ} {a : ℕ},
  Langlands.Tate.NonArchimedean.IsTrivialOnHigherUnits v χ a →
    a ≠ 0 →
      ∀ (s : ℂ),
        Langlands.Tate.NonArchimedean.zetaIntegral v (Langlands.Tate.NonArchimedean.testFunction v a) χ s =
          ↑((1 - (Langlands.Tate.NonArchimedean.q v)⁻¹)⁻¹ * (Langlands.Tate.NonArchimedean.q v)⁻¹ ^ a)

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K]
  (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K))
  (χ : (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion K v)ˣ →* ℂˣ),
  (∀ (u : (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion K v)ˣ), ‖↑u‖ = 1 → χ u = 1) →
    ∀ (ϖ : (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion K v)ˣ),
      ‖↑ϖ‖ = (Langlands.Tate.NonArchimedean.q v)⁻¹ →
        ∀ (s : ℂ),
          ‖↑(χ ϖ)‖ < Langlands.Tate.NonArchimedean.q v ^ s.re →
            Langlands.Tate.NonArchimedean.zetaIntegral v ((Metric.closedBall 0 1).indicator 1) χ s =
              (1 - ↑(χ ϖ) * ↑(Langlands.Tate.NonArchimedean.q v) ^ (-s))⁻¹

Langlands.Tate.NonArchimedean.zpow_neg_n.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K]
  (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)) (m : ℕ),
  Langlands.Tate.NonArchimedean.q v ^ (-↑m) = (Langlands.Tate.NonArchimedean.q v)⁻¹ ^ m

Langlands.Tate.NonzeroElt.type:
{K : Type u_1} →
  [inst : Field K] → (FractionalIdeal (nonZeroDivisors (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)) K)ˣ → Type (max 0 u_1)

Langlands.Tate.Orbits.type:
{K : Type u_1} →
  [inst : Field K] →
    [NumberField K] →
      (FractionalIdeal (nonZeroDivisors (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)) K)ˣ →
        Set ↥(nonZeroDivisors (Ideal (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)))

Langlands.Tate.Orbits.congr_simp.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K]
  (a a_1 : (FractionalIdeal (nonZeroDivisors (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)) K)ˣ),
  a = a_1 →
    ∀ (a_2 a_3 : ↥(nonZeroDivisors (Ideal (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)))),
      a_2 = a_3 → Langlands.Tate.Orbits a a_2 = Langlands.Tate.Orbits a_1 a_3

Langlands.Tate.absNorm_dualUnit.type:
∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K]
  (a : (FractionalIdeal (nonZeroDivisors (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)) K)ˣ),
  ↑(FractionalIdeal.absNorm ↑(Langlands.Tate.dualUnit K a)) =
    (↑(FractionalIdeal.absNorm ↑a) * |↑(NumberField.discr K)|)⁻¹

Langlands.Tate.absNorm_pos.type:
∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K]
  (a : (FractionalIdeal (nonZeroDivisors (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)) K)ˣ), 0 < ↑(FractionalIdeal.absNorm ↑a)

Langlands.Tate.absNorm_toPrincipalIdeal_.type:
∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] (x : Kˣ)
  (a : (FractionalIdeal (nonZeroDivisors (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)) K)ˣ),
  ↑(FractionalIdeal.absNorm ↑((toPrincipalIdeal (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K) K) x * a)) =
    |↑((Algebra.norm ℚ) ↑x)| * ↑(FractionalIdeal.absNorm ↑a)

Langlands.Tate.abs_det_mul_prod_cpow.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] (x : NumberField.mixedEmbedding.realSpace K) (s : ℂ),
  ↑|(NumberField.mixedEmbedding.fundamentalCone.fderiv_expMapBasis K x).det| *
      ∏ w, ↑(↑NumberField.mixedEmbedding.fundamentalCone.expMapBasis x w) ^ (↑w.mult * s / 2 - 1) =
    ↑(Langlands.Tate.unitConst K) *
      Complex.exp (↑(Module.finrank ℚ K) * s / 2 * ↑(x NumberField.Units.dirichletUnitTheorem.w₀))

Langlands.Tate.abs_norm_eq_of_span_eq_mu.type:
∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K]
  (J I : ↥(nonZeroDivisors (Ideal (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)))) {α : NumberField.RingOfIntegers K},
  Ideal.span {α} = ↑J * ↑I → |↑((Algebra.norm ℚ) ↑α)| = ↑(Ideal.absNorm ↑J) * ↑(Ideal.absNorm ↑I)

Langlands.Tate.abs_norm_orbitRep.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K]
  (a : (FractionalIdeal (nonZeroDivisors (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)) K)ˣ) (I : ↑(Langlands.Tate.Orbits a)),
  |↑((Algebra.norm ℚ) ↑↑(Langlands.Tate.orbitRep a I))| = ↑(FractionalIdeal.absNorm ↑a) * ↑(Ideal.absNorm ↑↑I)

Langlands.Tate.abs_norm_pos.type: ∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] {α : K}, α ≠ 0 → 0 < |↑((Algebra.norm ℚ) α)|

Langlands.Tate.analyticAt_Gammaℂ.type: ∀ {s : ℂ}, s.Gammaℂ ≠ 0 → AnalyticAt ℂ Complex.Gammaℂ s

Langlands.Tate.analyticAt_Gammaℝ.type: ∀ {s : ℂ}, s.Gammaℝ ≠ 0 → AnalyticAt ℂ Complex.Gammaℝ s

Langlands.Tate.analyticAt_heckeLambdaOne.type:
∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] {s : ℂ},
  s ≠ 0 → s ≠ 1 → AnalyticAt ℂ (Langlands.Tate.heckeLambdaOne K) s

Langlands.Tate.analyticAt_of_differentia.type: ∀ {f : ℂ → ℂ}, (Differentiable ℂ fun s => (f s)⁻¹) → ∀ {s : ℂ}, f s ≠ 0 → AnalyticAt ℂ f s

Langlands.Tate.analyticAt_poleShape.type:
∀ {E F₀ F₁ : ℂ → ℂ},
  Differentiable ℂ E →
    Differentiable ℂ F₀ →
      Differentiable ℂ F₁ → ∀ {u : ℂ}, u ≠ 0 → u ≠ 1 → AnalyticAt ℂ (fun u => E u + F₀ u / u + F₁ u / (u - 1)) u

Langlands.Tate.archChar_neg.type: ∀ (m : ℕ) (n : ℤ) (t : ℂ) {z : ℂ}, z ≠ 0 → Langlands.Tate.archChar m (-n) (-t) z = (Langlands.Tate.archChar m n t z)⁻¹

Langlands.Tate.archChar_neg_mul_archChar.type: ∀ (m : ℕ) (n : ℤ) (t : ℂ) {z : ℂ}, z ≠ 0 → Langlands.Tate.archChar m (-n) (-t) z * Langlands.Tate.archChar m n t z = 1

Langlands.Tate.archChar_neg_ofReal.type: ∀ (m : ℕ) (n : ℤ) (t : ℂ) (r : ℝ), Langlands.Tate.archChar m (-n) t ↑r = Langlands.Tate.archChar m n t ↑r

Langlands.Tate.archDualZeta.type: {K : Type u_1} → [inst : Field K] → NumberField.InfinitePlace K → ℤ → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ

Langlands.Tate.archDualZeta_eq.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {v : NumberField.InfinitePlace K} {n : ℤ} {t s : ℂ},
  (v.IsReal → n = 0 ∨ n = 1) →
    0 < (s + t).re →
      (s + t).re < 1 →
        Langlands.Tate.archDualZeta v n t s =
          Langlands.Tate.archRootNumber v n *
              (Langlands.Tate.archGamma v (if v.IsReal then n else -n) (-t) (1 - s) /
                Langlands.Tate.archGamma v n t s) *
            Langlands.Tate.archZeta v n t s

Langlands.Tate.archDualZeta_eq_gamma.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {v : NumberField.InfinitePlace K} {n : ℤ} {t s : ℂ},
  (v.IsReal → n = 0 ∨ n = 1) →
    (s + t).re < 1 →
      Langlands.Tate.archDualZeta v n t s =
        Langlands.Tate.archRootNumber v n *
          ((if v.IsReal then 1 else ↑Real.pi) * Langlands.Tate.archGamma v (if v.IsReal then n else -n) (-t) (1 - s))

Langlands.Tate.archGamma.type: {K : Type u_1} → [inst : Field K] → NumberField.InfinitePlace K → ℤ → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ

Langlands.Tate.archGamma_ne_zero.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {v : NumberField.InfinitePlace K} {n : ℤ} {t s : ℂ},
  (v.IsReal → 0 ≤ n) → 0 < (s + t).re → Langlands.Tate.archGamma v n t s ≠ 0

Langlands.Tate.archRootNumber.type: {K : Type u_1} → [inst : Field K] → NumberField.InfinitePlace K → ℤ → ℂ

Langlands.Tate.archZeta.type: {K : Type u_1} → [inst : Field K] → NumberField.InfinitePlace K → ℤ → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ

Langlands.Tate.archZeta_eq.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {v : NumberField.InfinitePlace K} {n : ℤ} {t s : ℂ},
  (v.IsReal → n = 0 ∨ n = 1) →
    0 < (s + t).re →
      Langlands.Tate.archZeta v n t s = (if v.IsReal then 1 else ↑Real.pi) * Langlands.Tate.archGamma v n t s

Langlands.Tate.bijective_insertMap.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K]
  {S : Finset (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K))}
  {v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)},
  v ∉ S → Function.Bijective (Langlands.Tate.insertMap S v)

Langlands.Tate.card_classGroup_ne_zero.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K],
  ↑(Fintype.card (ClassGroup (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K))) ≠ 0

Langlands.Tate.card_infinitePlace_of_isQ.type:
∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] [NumberField.IsTotallyComplex K],
  Module.finrank ℚ K = 2 → Fintype.card (NumberField.InfinitePlace K) = 1

Langlands.Tate.classChar.type:
{K : Type u_1} →
  [inst : Field K] →
    [inst_1 : NumberField K] →
      (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter K) → Langlands.Tate.IsClassType χ → ClassGroup (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K) →* ℂˣ

Langlands.Tate.classChar.congr_simp.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] (χ χ_1 : Langlands.HeckeCharacter K) (e_χ : χ = χ_1)
  (hχ : Langlands.Tate.IsClassType χ), Langlands.Tate.classChar χ hχ = Langlands.Tate.classChar χ_1 ⋯

Langlands.Tate.classCharE.type: {K : Type u_1} → [inst : Field K] → [NumberField K] → (ClassGroup (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K) →* ℂˣ) → ℂ → ℂ

Langlands.Tate.classCharE.congr_simp.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] (ψ ψ_1 : ClassGroup (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K) →* ℂˣ),
  ψ = ψ_1 → ∀ (u u_1 : ℂ), u = u_1 → Langlands.Tate.classCharE ψ u = Langlands.Tate.classCharE ψ_1 u_1

Langlands.Tate.classCharF₀.type: {K : Type u_1} → [inst : Field K] → [NumberField K] → (ClassGroup (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K) →* ℂˣ) → ℂ → ℂ

Langlands.Tate.classCharF₀.congr_simp.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] (ψ ψ_1 : ClassGroup (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K) →* ℂˣ),
  ψ = ψ_1 → ∀ (u u_1 : ℂ), u = u_1 → Langlands.Tate.classCharF₀ ψ u = Langlands.Tate.classCharF₀ ψ_1 u_1

Langlands.Tate.classCharF₀_zero.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] (ψ : ClassGroup (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K) →* ℂˣ),
  ψ ≠ 1 → Langlands.Tate.classCharF₀ ψ 0 = 0

Langlands.Tate.classCharF₁.type: {K : Type u_1} → [inst : Field K] → [NumberField K] → (ClassGroup (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K) →* ℂˣ) → ℂ → ℂ

Langlands.Tate.classCharF₁.congr_simp.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] (ψ ψ_1 : ClassGroup (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K) →* ℂˣ),
  ψ = ψ_1 → ∀ (u u_1 : ℂ), u = u_1 → Langlands.Tate.classCharF₁ ψ u = Langlands.Tate.classCharF₁ ψ_1 u_1

Langlands.Tate.classCharF₁_one.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] (ψ : ClassGroup (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K) →* ℂˣ),
  ψ ≠ 1 → Langlands.Tate.classCharF₁ ψ 1 = 0

Langlands.Tate.classCharL.type: {K : Type u_1} → [inst : Field K] → [NumberField K] → (ClassGroup (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K) →* ℂˣ) → ℂ → ℂ

Langlands.Tate.classCharL.congr_simp.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] (ψ ψ_1 : ClassGroup (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K) →* ℂˣ),
  ψ = ψ_1 → ∀ (u u_1 : ℂ), u = u_1 → Langlands.Tate.classCharL ψ u = Langlands.Tate.classCharL ψ_1 u_1

Langlands.Tate.classCharLambda.type: {K : Type u_1} → [inst : Field K] → [NumberField K] → (ClassGroup (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K) →* ℂˣ) → ℂ → ℂ

Langlands.Tate.classCharLambda_eq.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] (ψ : ClassGroup (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K) →* ℂˣ),
  ψ ≠ 1 → ∀ {u : ℂ}, u ≠ 0 → u ≠ 1 → Langlands.Tate.classCharLambda ψ u = Langlands.Tate.classCharXi ψ u

Langlands.Tate.classCharLambda_eq_classC.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] (ψ : ClassGroup (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K) →* ℂˣ),
  ψ ≠ 1 →
    ∀ {u : ℂ},
      1 < u.re →
        Langlands.Tate.classCharLambda ψ u =
          ↑√|↑(NumberField.discr K)| ^ u * Langlands.Tate.gammaK K u * Langlands.Tate.classCharL ψ u

Langlands.Tate.classCharLambda_one_sub.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] (ψ : ClassGroup (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K) →* ℂˣ),
  ψ ≠ 1 →
    ∀ (u : ℂ),
      Langlands.Tate.classCharLambda ψ (1 - u) =
        ↑(ψ ((ClassGroup.mk K) (Langlands.Tate.differentUnit K))) * Langlands.Tate.classCharLambda ψ⁻¹ u

Langlands.Tate.classCharWeight.type:
{K : Type u_1} →
  [inst : Field K] →
    [NumberField K] →
      (ClassGroup (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K) →* ℂˣ) →
        ℂ → ↥(nonZeroDivisors (Ideal (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K))) →* ℂ

Langlands.Tate.classCharWeight_apply.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] (φ : ClassGroup (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K) →* ℂˣ) (s : ℂ)
  (I : ↥(nonZeroDivisors (Ideal (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)))),
  (Langlands.Tate.classCharWeight φ s) I = ↑(φ (ClassGroup.mk0 I)) * ↑(Ideal.absNorm ↑I) ^ (-s)

Langlands.Tate.classCharXi.type: {K : Type u_1} → [inst : Field K] → [NumberField K] → (ClassGroup (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K) →* ℂˣ) → ℂ → ℂ

Langlands.Tate.classCharXi_eq.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] (ψ : ClassGroup (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K) →* ℂˣ)
  {u : ℂ},
  1 < u.re →
    Langlands.Tate.classCharXi ψ u =
      ↑√|↑(NumberField.discr K)| ^ u * Langlands.Tate.gammaK K u * Langlands.Tate.classCharL ψ u

Langlands.Tate.classCharXi_eq_poleShape.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] (ψ : ClassGroup (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K) →* ℂˣ)
  (u : ℂ),
  Langlands.Tate.classCharXi ψ u =
    Langlands.Tate.classCharE ψ u + Langlands.Tate.classCharF₀ ψ u / u + Langlands.Tate.classCharF₁ ψ u / (u - 1)

Langlands.Tate.classCharXi_one.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] (u : ℂ),
  Langlands.Tate.classCharXi 1 u = Langlands.Tate.dedekindXi K u

Langlands.Tate.classCharXi_one_sub.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] (ψ : ClassGroup (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K) →* ℂˣ)
  {u : ℂ},
  u ≠ 0 →
    u ≠ 1 →
      Langlands.Tate.classCharXi ψ (1 - u) =
        ↑(ψ ((ClassGroup.mk K) (Langlands.Tate.differentUnit K))) * Langlands.Tate.classCharXi ψ⁻¹ u

Langlands.Tate.classChar_inv_eq.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] (ψ : ClassGroup (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K) →* ℂˣ)
  (C : ClassGroup (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)),
  ↑(ψ C⁻¹) = ↑(ψ ((ClassGroup.mk K) (Langlands.Tate.differentUnit K))) * ↑(ψ⁻¹ ((Langlands.Tate.dualClass K) C)⁻¹)

Langlands.Tate.classFactor.type:

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K]

    Langlands.Tate.classFactor a u * (Langlands.Tate.unitThetaFEPair a).Λ₀ (↑(Module.finrank ℚ K) * u / 2) +

      2 * (Langlands.Tate.unitThetaFEPair a).ε / ↑(Module.finrank ℚ K) * Langlands.Tate.classFactor a u / (u - 1)

Langlands.Tate.classZeta.congr_simp.type:

Langlands.Tate.classZeta_eq.type:
∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] [NumberField.IsTotallyComplex K],
  Module.finrank ℚ K = 2 →
    ∀ {s : ℂ},
      2 < s.re →
        Langlands.Tate.classZeta K s =
          s.Gammaℝ *
            ∑ C,
              ↑(Langlands.Tate.idealScale K (Langlands.Tate.classRep K C)) ^ s *
                ∑' (α : ↥↑(Langlands.Tate.classRep K C)), if ↑α = 0 then 0 else ↑√(2 * |↑((Algebra.norm ℚ) ↑α)|) ^ (-s)

Langlands.Tate.classZeta_two_mul.type:

      1 < u.re →

Langlands.Tate.coe_dualUnit_eq.type:
∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K]

  ↑((Langlands.Tate.globalDualEquiv K c a c' h) β) = (Langlands.Tate.globalConjEmbedding K fun w => ↑(c' w)) ↑β

∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] (c : NumberField.InfinitePlace K → ℝˣ)

    [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ V] →

        [inst_3 : MeasurableSpace V] →

Langlands.Tate.completedEpsteinZeta_cong.type:
∀ {V : Type u_1} {W : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup V] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ V]
  [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℝ V] [inst_3 : MeasurableSpace V] [inst_4 : BorelSpace V] [inst_5 : Nontrivial V]
  [inst_6 : NormedAddCommGroup W] [inst_7 : InnerProductSpace ℝ W] [inst_8 : FiniteDimensional ℝ W]
  [inst_9 : MeasurableSpace W] [inst_10 : BorelSpace W] [inst_11 : Nontrivial W] (L : Submodule ℤ V)
  [inst_12 : DiscreteTopology ↥L] [inst_13 : IsZLattice ℝ L] (M : Submodule ℤ W) [inst_14 : DiscreteTopology ↥M]
  [inst_15 : IsZLattice ℝ M],
  Module.finrank ℝ V = Module.finrank ℝ W →
    (∀ (t : ℝ), Langlands.Tate.latticeTheta L t = Langlands.Tate.latticeTheta M t) →
      ZLattice.covolume L MeasureTheory.volume = ZLattice.covolume M MeasureTheory.volume →
        Langlands.Tate.completedEpsteinZeta L = Langlands.Tate.completedEpsteinZeta M

Langlands.Tate.completedEpsteinZeta_eq.type:
∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup V] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℝ V]
  [inst_3 : MeasurableSpace V] [inst_4 : BorelSpace V] (L : Submodule ℤ V) [inst_5 : DiscreteTopology ↥L]
  [inst_6 : IsZLattice ℝ L] [inst_7 : Nontrivial V] {s : ℂ},
  ↑(Module.finrank ℝ V) < s.re → Langlands.Tate.completedEpsteinZeta L s = s.Gammaℝ * Langlands.Tate.epsteinZeta L s

Langlands.Tate.completedEpsteinZeta_resi.type:
∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup V] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℝ V]
  [inst_3 : MeasurableSpace V] [inst_4 : BorelSpace V] (L : Submodule ℤ V) [inst_5 : DiscreteTopology ↥L]
  [inst_6 : IsZLattice ℝ L] [inst_7 : Nontrivial V],
  Filter.Tendsto (fun s => (s - ↑(Module.finrank ℝ V)) * Langlands.Tate.completedEpsteinZeta L s)
    (nhdsWithin ↑(Module.finrank ℝ V) {↑(Module.finrank ℝ V)}ᶜ)
    (nhds (2 * ↑(ZLattice.covolume L MeasureTheory.volume)⁻¹))

Langlands.Tate.completedEpsteinZeta_sub.type:
∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup V] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℝ V]
  [inst_3 : MeasurableSpace V] [inst_4 : BorelSpace V] (L : Submodule ℤ V) [inst_5 : DiscreteTopology ↥L]
  [inst_6 : IsZLattice ℝ L] [inst_7 : Nontrivial V] (s : ℂ),
  Langlands.Tate.completedEpsteinZeta L (↑(Module.finrank ℝ V) - s) =
    ↑(ZLattice.covolume L MeasureTheory.volume)⁻¹ * Langlands.Tate.completedEpsteinZeta (Langlands.Tate.dualLattice L) s

Langlands.Tate.completedIdealZeta.type:
(K : Type u_1) →
  [inst : Field K] → [NumberField K] → (FractionalIdeal (nonZeroDivisors (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)) K)ˣ → ℂ → ℂ

Langlands.Tate.completedIdealZeta.congr_.type:
∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K]
  (a a_1 : (FractionalIdeal (nonZeroDivisors (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)) K)ˣ),
  a = a_1 →
    ∀ (s s_1 : ℂ), s = s_1 → Langlands.Tate.completedIdealZeta K a s = Langlands.Tate.completedIdealZeta K a_1 s_1

Langlands.Tate.completedIdealZeta_eq.type:
∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K]
  (a : (FractionalIdeal (nonZeroDivisors (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)) K)ˣ) {s : ℂ},
  ↑(Module.finrank ℚ K) < s.re →
    Langlands.Tate.completedIdealZeta K a s =
      s.Gammaℝ * ∑' (α : ↥↑a), if ↑α = 0 then 0 else ↑√(∑ w, ↑w.mult * w ↑α ^ 2) ^ (-s)

Langlands.Tate.completedIdealZeta_eq_of_.type:
∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] [NumberField.IsTotallyComplex K],
  Module.finrank ℚ K = 2 →
    ∀ (a : (FractionalIdeal (nonZeroDivisors (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)) K)ˣ) {s : ℂ},
      2 < s.re →
        Langlands.Tate.completedIdealZeta K a s =
          s.Gammaℝ * ∑' (α : ↥↑a), if ↑α = 0 then 0 else ↑√(2 * |↑((Algebra.norm ℚ) ↑α)|) ^ (-s)

Langlands.Tate.completedIdealZeta_residu.type:
∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K]
  (a : (FractionalIdeal (nonZeroDivisors (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)) K)ˣ),
  Filter.Tendsto (fun s => (s - ↑(Module.finrank ℚ K)) * Langlands.Tate.completedIdealZeta K a s)
    (nhdsWithin ↑(Module.finrank ℚ K) {↑(Module.finrank ℚ K)}ᶜ)
    (nhds (2 * ↑(↑(FractionalIdeal.absNorm ↑a) * √|↑(NumberField.discr K)|)⁻¹))

Langlands.Tate.completedIdealZeta_sub.type:
∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K]
  (a : (FractionalIdeal (nonZeroDivisors (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)) K)ˣ) (s : ℂ),
  Langlands.Tate.completedIdealZeta K a (↑(Module.finrank ℚ K) - s) =
    ↑(↑(FractionalIdeal.absNorm ↑a) * √|↑(NumberField.discr K)|)⁻¹ *
      Langlands.Tate.completedIdealZeta K (Langlands.Tate.dualUnit K a) s

Langlands.Tate.completedIdealZeta_toPrin.type:
∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] [NumberField.IsTotallyComplex K],
  Module.finrank ℚ K = 2 →
    ∀ (x : Kˣ) (a : (FractionalIdeal (nonZeroDivisors (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)) K)ˣ) {s : ℂ},
      2 < s.re →
        Langlands.Tate.completedIdealZeta K ((toPrincipalIdeal (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K) K) x * a) s =
          ↑√|↑((Algebra.norm ℚ) ↑x)| ^ (-s) * Langlands.Tate.completedIdealZeta K a s

Langlands.Tate.completedLFunction_of_nor.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] {χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter K} {s₀ : ℂ},
  (∀ (x : NumberField.IdeleGroup (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K) K), ↑(χ ↑x) = ↑(Langlands.ideleNorm K x) ^ s₀) →
    ∀ {n : NumberField.InfinitePlace K → ℤ} {t : NumberField.InfinitePlace K → ℂ},
      (∀ (v : NumberField.InfinitePlace K), χ.IsArchimedeanParameter v (n v) (t v)) →
        ∀ {s : ℂ}, 1 < (s + s₀).re → χ.completedLFunction n t s = Langlands.Tate.heckeLambdaOne K (s + s₀)

Langlands.Tate.completedLFunction_of_twi.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] {χ ξ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter K} {s₀ : ℂ},
  (∀ (x : NumberField.IdeleGroup (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K) K),
      ↑(ξ ↑x) = ↑(χ ↑x) * ↑(Langlands.ideleNorm K x) ^ s₀) →
    ∀ (n : NumberField.InfinitePlace K → ℤ) (t : NumberField.InfinitePlace K → ℂ) (s : ℂ),
      ξ.completedLFunction n t s = χ.completedLFunction n (fun v => t v - s₀) (s + s₀)

Langlands.Tate.completedQuadraticZeta.type: (K : Type u_1) → [inst : Field K] → [NumberField K] → ℂ → ℂ

Langlands.Tate.completedQuadraticZeta_eq.type:
∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] [NumberField.IsTotallyComplex K],

    ∀ {u : ℂ},
      1 < u.re →
        Langlands.Tate.completedQuadraticZeta K u =
          ↑(NumberField.Units.torsionOrder K) / 2 * ↑√|↑(NumberField.discr K)| ^ u * u.Gammaℂ *
            NumberField.dedekindZeta K u

Langlands.Tate.completedQuadraticZeta_on.type:
∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] [NumberField.IsTotallyComplex K],

    ∀ {u : ℂ},

Langlands.Tate.complexFourier_complexTes.type:
∀ (n : ℤ),

Langlands.Tate.complexFourier_eq_fourier.type: ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ) (w : ℂ), Langlands.Tate.complexFourier f w = 2 * FourierTransform.fourier f (2 * (starRingEnd ℂ) w)

Langlands.Tate.complexFourier_gaussConj.type:

  Langlands.Tate.complexFourier (Langlands.Tate.gaussConj k) = fun w => (-Complex.I) ^ k * Langlands.Tate.gaussHol k w

Langlands.Tate.complexFourier_gaussHol.type:

  Langlands.Tate.complexFourier (Langlands.Tate.gaussHol k) = fun w => (-Complex.I) ^ k * Langlands.Tate.gaussConj k w

Langlands.Tate.complexTest_eq.type:
∀ (n : ℤ),
  Langlands.Tate.complexTest n = if 0 ≤ n then Langlands.Tate.gaussConj n.natAbs else Langlands.Tate.gaussHol n.natAbs

Langlands.Tate.complexTest_mul_archChar.type:
∀ (n : ℤ) (t z : ℂ),
  Langlands.Tate.complexTest n z * Langlands.Tate.archChar 2 n t z =
    ↑‖z‖ ^ n.natAbs * Complex.exp (-(↑(2 * Real.pi) * ↑‖z‖ ^ 2)) * ↑‖z‖ ^ (2 * t)

Langlands.Tate.complexZeta_complexFourie.type:
∀ (n : ℤ) {t s : ℂ},
  (s + t).re < 1 →
    Langlands.Tate.complexZeta (Langlands.Tate.complexFourier (Langlands.Tate.complexTest n)) (-n) (-t) (1 - s) =
      Langlands.Tate.complexRootNumber n * (↑Real.pi * (1 - s - t + ↑|n| / 2).Gammaℂ)

Langlands.Tate.complexZeta_complexTest.type:
∀ (n : ℤ) {t s : ℂ},
  0 < (s + t).re →
    Langlands.Tate.complexZeta (Langlands.Tate.complexTest n) n t s = ↑Real.pi * (s + t + ↑|n| / 2).Gammaℂ

Langlands.Tate.complexZeta_const_mul.type:
∀ (c : ℂ) (f : ℂ → ℂ) (n : ℤ) (t s : ℂ),
  Langlands.Tate.complexZeta (fun z => c * f z) n t s = c * Langlands.Tate.complexZeta f n t s

Langlands.Tate.complex_local_functional_.type:
∀ (n : ℤ) {t s : ℂ},
  0 < (s + t).re →
    (s + t).re < 1 →
      Langlands.Tate.complexZeta (Langlands.Tate.complexFourier (Langlands.Tate.complexTest n)) (-n) (-t) (1 - s) =
        Langlands.Tate.complexRootNumber n * ((1 - s - t + ↑|n| / 2).Gammaℂ / (s + t + ↑|n| / 2).Gammaℂ) *
          Langlands.Tate.complexZeta (Langlands.Tate.complexTest n) n t s

Langlands.Tate.conductor_ne_bot.type: ∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] (χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter K), χ.conductor ≠ ⊥

Langlands.Tate.conductor_of_normPower.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] {χ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter K} {s₀ : ℂ},
  (∀ (x : NumberField.IdeleGroup (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K) K), ↑(χ ↑x) = ↑(Langlands.ideleNorm K x) ^ s₀) →
    χ.conductor = 1

Langlands.Tate.conductor_of_twist.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] {χ ξ : Langlands.HeckeCharacter K} {s₀ : ℂ},
  (∀ (x : NumberField.IdeleGroup (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K) K),
      ↑(ξ ↑x) = ↑(χ ↑x) * ↑(Langlands.ideleNorm K x) ^ s₀) →
    ξ.conductor = χ.conductor

Langlands.Tate.covolume_comap_linearEqui.type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
  [inst_3 : MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure] (L : Submodule ℤ E)
  [inst_6 : DiscreteTopology ↥L] [IsZLattice ℝ L] (e : E ≃L[ℝ] E),
  ZLattice.covolume (ZLattice.comap ℝ L ↑↑e) μ = |LinearMap.det ↑↑e|⁻¹ * ZLattice.covolume L μ

Langlands.Tate.covolume_dualLattice.type:
∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup V] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℝ V]
  [inst_3 : MeasurableSpace V] [inst_4 : BorelSpace V] (L : Submodule ℤ V) [inst_5 : DiscreteTopology ↥L]
  [IsZLattice ℝ L],
  ZLattice.covolume (Langlands.Tate.dualLattice L) MeasureTheory.volume = (ZLattice.covolume L MeasureTheory.volume)⁻¹

Langlands.Tate.covolume_dualLattice_trac.type:
∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K]
  (a : (FractionalIdeal (nonZeroDivisors (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)) K)ˣ),
  ZLattice.covolume (Langlands.Tate.dualLattice (Langlands.Tate.traceLattice K a)) MeasureTheory.volume =
    ZLattice.covolume (Langlands.Tate.traceLattice K (Langlands.Tate.dualUnit K a)) MeasureTheory.volume

Langlands.Tate.covolume_globalLattice.type:
∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] (c : NumberField.InfinitePlace K → ℝˣ)
  (a : (FractionalIdeal (nonZeroDivisors (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)) K)ˣ),
  ZLattice.covolume (Langlands.Tate.globalLattice K c a) MeasureTheory.volume =
    (∏ w, |↑(c w)| ^ w.mult) *
      (↑(FractionalIdeal.absNorm ↑a) * 2⁻¹ ^ NumberField.InfinitePlace.nrComplexPlaces K * √|↑(NumberField.discr K)|)

Langlands.Tate.covolume_globalLattice_th.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K]
  (a : (FractionalIdeal (nonZeroDivisors (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)) K)ˣ) {t : NumberField.InfinitePlace K → ℝ}
  (ht : ∀ (w : NumberField.InfinitePlace K), 0 < t w),
  ZLattice.covolume (Langlands.Tate.globalLattice K (Langlands.Tate.thetaScale ht) a) MeasureTheory.volume =
    ↑(FractionalIdeal.absNorm ↑a) * √|↑(NumberField.discr K)| * ∏ w, √(t w) ^ w.mult

Langlands.Tate.covolume_traceLattice.type:
∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K]

  ZLattice.covolume (Langlands.Tate.traceLattice K a) MeasureTheory.volume =
    ↑(FractionalIdeal.absNorm ↑a) * √|↑(NumberField.discr K)|

Langlands.Tate.dedekindTheta.type:
(K : Type u_1) →
  [inst : Field K] →
    [NumberField K] →
      FractionalIdeal (nonZeroDivisors (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)) K → (NumberField.InfinitePlace K → ℝ) → ℝ

Langlands.Tate.dedekindTheta.congr_simp.type:
∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K]
  (I I_1 : FractionalIdeal (nonZeroDivisors (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)) K),
  I = I_1 →
    ∀ (t t_1 : NumberField.InfinitePlace K → ℝ),
      t = t_1 → Langlands.Tate.dedekindTheta K I t = Langlands.Tate.dedekindTheta K I_1 t_1

Langlands.Tate.dedekindTheta_anti.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K]
  (a : (FractionalIdeal (nonZeroDivisors (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)) K)ˣ) {s t : NumberField.InfinitePlace K → ℝ},
  (∀ (w : NumberField.InfinitePlace K), 0 < s w) →
    (∀ (w : NumberField.InfinitePlace K), s w ≤ t w) →
      Langlands.Tate.dedekindTheta K (↑a) t ≤ Langlands.Tate.dedekindTheta K (↑a) s

Langlands.Tate.dedekindTheta_const.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K]
  (a : (FractionalIdeal (nonZeroDivisors (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)) K)ˣ) (t : ℝ),
  (Langlands.Tate.dedekindTheta K ↑a fun x => t) = Langlands.Tate.latticeTheta (Langlands.Tate.traceLattice K a) t

Langlands.Tate.dedekindTheta_dual.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K]
  (a : (FractionalIdeal (nonZeroDivisors (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)) K)ˣ) {t : NumberField.InfinitePlace K → ℝ},
  (∀ (w : NumberField.InfinitePlace K), 0 < t w) →
    Langlands.Tate.dedekindTheta K (↑a) t =
      (↑(FractionalIdeal.absNorm ↑a) * √|↑(NumberField.discr K)| * ∏ w, √(t w) ^ w.mult)⁻¹ *
        Langlands.Tate.dedekindTheta K (FractionalIdeal.dual ℤ ℚ ↑a) fun w => (t w)⁻¹

Langlands.Tate.dedekindTheta_dual_const.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K]
  (a : (FractionalIdeal (nonZeroDivisors (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)) K)ˣ) {t : ℝ},
  0 < t →
    (Langlands.Tate.dedekindTheta K ↑a fun x => t) =
      (↑(FractionalIdeal.absNorm ↑a) * √|↑(NumberField.discr K)| * √t ^ Module.finrank ℚ K)⁻¹ *
        Langlands.Tate.dedekindTheta K (FractionalIdeal.dual ℤ ℚ ↑a) fun x => t⁻¹

Langlands.Tate.dedekindTheta_eq_tsum_glo.type:
∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K]
  (a : (FractionalIdeal (nonZeroDivisors (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)) K)ˣ) {t : NumberField.InfinitePlace K → ℝ}
  (ht : ∀ (w : NumberField.InfinitePlace K), 0 < t w),
  Langlands.Tate.dedekindTheta K (↑a) t =
    ∑' (ℓ : ↥(Langlands.Tate.globalLattice K (Langlands.Tate.thetaScale ht) a)), Real.exp (-(Real.pi * 1) * ‖↑ℓ‖ ^ 2)

Langlands.Tate.dedekindTheta_inv_mul_dif.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K]
  (a : (FractionalIdeal (nonZeroDivisors (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)) K)ˣ) {t : NumberField.InfinitePlace K → ℝ},
  (∀ (w : NumberField.InfinitePlace K), 0 < t w) →
    Langlands.Tate.dedekindTheta K (↑a) t =
      (↑(FractionalIdeal.absNorm ↑a) * √|↑(NumberField.discr K)| * ∏ w, √(t w) ^ w.mult)⁻¹ *
        Langlands.Tate.dedekindTheta K (↑a * ↑(differentIdeal ℤ (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)))⁻¹ fun w => (t w)⁻¹

Langlands.Tate.dedekindTheta_unit.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K]
  (I : FractionalIdeal (nonZeroDivisors (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)) K) (u : (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)ˣ)
  (t : NumberField.InfinitePlace K → ℝ),
  (Langlands.Tate.dedekindTheta K I fun w => t w * w ((algebraMap (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K) K) ↑u) ^ 2) =
    Langlands.Tate.dedekindTheta K I t

Langlands.Tate.dedekindTheta_unitScale_a.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K]
  (I : FractionalIdeal (nonZeroDivisors (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)) K) (y : ℝ)
  (c : Fin (NumberField.Units.rank K) → ℝ) (k : Fin (NumberField.Units.rank K) → ℤ),
  Langlands.Tate.dedekindTheta K I (Langlands.Tate.unitScale K y (c + fun i => ↑(k i))) =
    Langlands.Tate.dedekindTheta K I (Langlands.Tate.unitScale K y c)

Langlands.Tate.dedekindTheta_unitScale_i.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K]
  (a : (FractionalIdeal (nonZeroDivisors (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)) K)ˣ) {y : ℝ},
  0 < y →
    ∀ (c : Fin (NumberField.Units.rank K) → ℝ),
      Langlands.Tate.dedekindTheta K (↑a) (Langlands.Tate.unitScale K y⁻¹ c) =
        (↑(FractionalIdeal.absNorm ↑a) * √|↑(NumberField.discr K)|)⁻¹ * √y ^ Module.finrank ℚ K *
          Langlands.Tate.dedekindTheta K (↑(Langlands.Tate.dualUnit K a)) (Langlands.Tate.unitScale K y (-c))

Langlands.Tate.dedekindXi.type: (K : Type u_1) → [inst : Field K] → [NumberField K] → ℂ → ℂ

Langlands.Tate.dedekindXi_eq.type:
∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] {u : ℂ},
  1 < u.re →
    Langlands.Tate.dedekindXi K u =
      ↑√|↑(NumberField.discr K)| ^ u * Langlands.Tate.gammaK K u * NumberField.dedekindZeta K u

Langlands.Tate.dedekindXi_eq_poleShape.type:
∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] (u : ℂ),
  Langlands.Tate.dedekindXi K u =
    Langlands.Tate.xiE K u + Langlands.Tate.xiF₀ K u / u + Langlands.Tate.xiF₁ K u / (u - 1)

Langlands.Tate.dedekindXi_one_sub.type:

Langlands.Tate.dedekindZeta_eq_of_hasSum.type:

Langlands.Tate.det_mixedScaleₗ.type:

  s = s_1 → Langlands.Tate.heckeLambdaOne K s = Langlands.Tate.heckeLambdaOne K s_1

Langlands.Tate.heckeLambdaOne_eq.type:
∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] {s : ℂ},
  1 < s.re →
    Langlands.Tate.heckeLambdaOne K s =
      2 ^ NumberField.InfinitePlace.nrComplexPlaces K * Langlands.Tate.gammaK K s * NumberField.dedekindZeta K s

Langlands.Tate.heckeLambdaOne_eq_discr_c.type:
∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] (s : ℂ),
  Langlands.Tate.heckeLambdaOne K s = ↑|NumberField.discr K| ^ (1 / 2 - s) * Langlands.Tate.heckeLambdaOne' K (1 - s)

Langlands.Tate.heckeLambdaOne_eq_poleSha.type:
∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K],
  Langlands.Tate.heckeLambdaOne K = fun u =>
    2 ^ NumberField.InfinitePlace.nrComplexPlaces K * ↑√|↑(NumberField.discr K)| ^ (-u) * Langlands.Tate.xiE K u +
        2 ^ NumberField.InfinitePlace.nrComplexPlaces K * ↑√|↑(NumberField.discr K)| ^ (-u) * Langlands.Tate.xiF₀ K u /
          u +
      2 ^ NumberField.InfinitePlace.nrComplexPlaces K * ↑√|↑(NumberField.discr K)| ^ (-u) * Langlands.Tate.xiF₁ K u /
        (u - 1)

  (∀ (x : NumberField.IdeleGroup (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K) K), ↑(χ ↑x) = ↑(Langlands.ideleNorm K x) ^ s₀) →
    ∀ (v : NumberField.InfinitePlace K) (x : v.Completionˣ),

    ∀ (v : NumberField.InfinitePlace K) (x : v.Completionˣ),
      ↑((ξ.infiniteComponent v) x) =

Langlands.Tate.integral_complex_radial.type: ∀ (g : ℝ → ℂ), ∫ (z : ℂ), g ‖z‖ = 2 * ↑Real.pi * ∫ (y : ℝ) in Set.Ioi 0, ↑y * g y

Langlands.Tate.integral_exp_mul_prod_eq_.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] {s : ℂ},

Langlands.Tate.integral_pi_cpow_mul_exp.type:

                ↑(Real.exp
                    (-(r i * t i))) ∂MeasureTheory.Measure.pi fun x => MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Ioi 0)) =
          ∏ i, Complex.exp (-(z i * ↑(Real.log (r i)))) * Complex.Gamma (z i)

Langlands.Tate.integral_real_radial.type: ∀ (g : ℝ → ℂ), ∫ (x : ℝ), g |x| = 2 * ∫ (y : ℝ) in Set.Ioi 0, g y

Langlands.Tate.integral_tile_zero_eq_int.type:

Langlands.Tate.latticeTheta_dualLattice_.type:
∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K]
  (a : (FractionalIdeal (nonZeroDivisors (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)) K)ˣ) (t : ℝ),

Langlands.Tate.latticeTheta_one_div.type:
∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup V] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℝ V]
  [inst_3 : MeasurableSpace V] [inst_4 : BorelSpace V] (L : Submodule ℤ V) [inst_5 : DiscreteTopology ↥L]
  [IsZLattice ℝ L] {x : ℝ},
  0 < x →
    Langlands.Tate.latticeTheta L (1 / x) =
      (ZLattice.covolume L MeasureTheory.volume)⁻¹ * x ^ (↑(Module.finrank ℝ V) / 2) *
        Langlands.Tate.latticeTheta (Langlands.Tate.dualLattice L) x

Langlands.Tate.latticeTheta_sub_one_le.type:

  (M : Submodule ℤ V) [inst_3 : DiscreteTopology ↥M] [IsZLattice ℝ M] {c : ℝ},
  (∀ (μ : ↥M), μ ≠ 0 → c ≤ ‖↑μ‖ ^ 2) →
    ∀ {t : ℝ},
      1 ≤ t →
        0 ≤ Langlands.Tate.latticeTheta M t - 1 ∧
          Langlands.Tate.latticeTheta M t - 1 ≤
            Real.exp (-(Real.pi * c) * (t - 1)) * (Langlands.Tate.latticeTheta M 1 - 1)

Langlands.Tate.lintegral_unitCube_eq_tsu.type:

    ∫⁻ (c : Fin (NumberField.Units.rank K) → ℝ) in Set.univ.pi fun x => Set.Ico 0 1,
        ENNReal.ofReal (Langlands.Tate.dedekindTheta K (↑a) (Langlands.Tate.unitScale K y c) - 1) =
      ∑' (I : ↑(Langlands.Tate.Orbits a)),
        ↑(NumberField.Units.torsionOrder K) *
          ∫⁻ (c : Fin (NumberField.Units.rank K) → ℝ),

Langlands.Tate.mixedScale.congr_simp.type:

Langlands.Tate.mixedScaleₗ.type:

Langlands.Tate.mixedScaleₗ_apply_fst.type:

Langlands.Tate.mixedScaleₗ_one.type: ∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] (x : NumberField.mixedEmbedding.mixedSpace K), (Langlands.Tate.mixedScaleₗ K 1) x = x

Langlands.Tate.mul_normPowerChar_apply.type:

Langlands.Tate.mult_mul_re_pos.type: ∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {s : ℂ}, 0 < s.re → ∀ (w : NumberField.InfinitePlace K), 0 < (↑w.mult * s / 2).re

Langlands.Tate.normCpow.congr_simp.type:

Langlands.Tate.normCpow_apply.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] (s : ℂ) (I : Ideal (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)),

  (I : ↥(nonZeroDivisors (Ideal (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)))) (s : ℂ),

Langlands.Tate.norm_classGroupChar.type:

  ‖2 * (f z * Langlands.Tate.archChar 2 n t z * ↑‖z‖ ^ (2 * s) / ↑‖z‖ ^ 2)‖ ≤ 2 * (‖z‖ ^ (2 * (s + t).re - 2) * ‖f z‖)

Langlands.Tate.norm_gaussConj.type: ∀ (k : ℕ) (z : ℂ), ‖Langlands.Tate.gaussConj k z‖ = ‖z‖ ^ k * Real.exp (-(2 * Real.pi) * ‖z‖ ^ 2)

Langlands.Tate.norm_globalConjEmbedding_.type:

  ‖(Langlands.Tate.globalConjEmbedding K c) x‖ ^ 2 = ∑ w, c w ^ 2 * w x ^ 2

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] {t : NumberField.InfinitePlace K → ℝ}
  (ht : ∀ (w : NumberField.InfinitePlace K), 0 < t w) (x : K),
  ‖(Langlands.Tate.globalConjEmbedding K fun w => ↑(Langlands.Tate.thetaScale ht w)) x‖ ^ 2 =

∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] (x : K),

Langlands.Tate.norm_globalEmbedding_sq.type:

Langlands.Tate.norm_le_dualMap.type:

Langlands.Tate.norm_normCpow_lt_one.type:

  (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)) {s : ℂ},

Langlands.Tate.norm_prod_archRootNumber.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] (n : NumberField.InfinitePlace K → ℤ),

Langlands.Tate.norm_realZeta_integrand_l.type:
∀ (f : ℝ → ℂ) (n : ℤ) (t s : ℂ) (x : ℝ),
  ‖f x * Langlands.Tate.archChar 1 n t ↑x * ↑|x| ^ s / ↑|x|‖ ≤ ‖x‖ ^ ((s + t).re - 1) * ‖f x‖

Langlands.Tate.norm_toMixed_symm_sq.type:
∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] (x : NumberField.mixedEmbedding.mixedSpace K),
  ‖(NumberField.mixedEmbedding.euclidean.toMixed K).symm x‖ ^ 2 = ∑ w, x.1 w ^ 2 + ∑ w, ‖x.2 w‖ ^ 2

Langlands.Tate.ofReal_cpow_eq_exp.type: ∀ {x : ℝ}, 0 < x → ∀ (z : ℂ), ↑x ^ z = Complex.exp (z * ↑(Real.log x))

Langlands.Tate.ofReal_dedekindTheta_sub_.type:

Langlands.Tate.one_div_cpow_eq_exp.type: ∀ {x : ℝ}, 0 < x → ∀ (z : ℂ), (1 / ↑x) ^ z = Complex.exp (-(z * ↑(Real.log x)))

Langlands.Tate.one_eq_of_isArchimedeanPa.type:

  Langlands.HeckeCharacter.IsArchimedeanParameter 1 v n t →
    ∀ (x : v.Completionˣ),
      1 =
        ((NumberField.InfinitePlace.Completion.extensionEmbedding v) ↑x /
              ↑‖(NumberField.InfinitePlace.Completion.extensionEmbedding v) ↑x‖) ^
            n *
          ↑‖(NumberField.InfinitePlace.Completion.extensionEmbedding v) ↑x‖ ^ (↑v.mult * t)

Langlands.Tate.one_le_dedekindTheta.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K]

Langlands.Tate.one_le_unitTheta.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K]
  (a : (FractionalIdeal (nonZeroDivisors (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)) K)ˣ) {y : ℝ},
  0 < y →
    1 ≤ Langlands.Tate.unitTheta K a y ∧
      Langlands.Tate.unitTheta K a y ≤
        Langlands.Tate.latticeTheta (Langlands.Tate.traceLattice K a) (y * Langlands.Tate.unitBound K)

Langlands.Tate.prod_abs_thetaScale.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] {t : NumberField.InfinitePlace K → ℝ}
  (ht : ∀ (w : NumberField.InfinitePlace K), 0 < t w),
  ∏ w, |↑(Langlands.Tate.thetaScale ht w)| ^ w.mult =
    2 ^ NumberField.InfinitePlace.nrComplexPlaces K * ∏ w, √(t w) ^ w.mult

Langlands.Tate.prod_archDualZeta.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] {n : NumberField.InfinitePlace K → ℤ}
  {t : NumberField.InfinitePlace K → ℂ} {s : ℂ},
  (∀ (v : NumberField.InfinitePlace K), v.IsReal → n v = 0 ∨ n v = 1) →
    (∀ (v : NumberField.InfinitePlace K), (s + t v).re < 1) →
      ∏ v, Langlands.Tate.archDualZeta v (n v) (t v) s =
        (∏ v, Langlands.Tate.archRootNumber v (n v)) *
          (↑Real.pi ^ NumberField.InfinitePlace.nrComplexPlaces K *
            Langlands.gammaFactor K (fun v => if v.IsReal then n v else -n v) (fun v => -t v) (1 - s))

Langlands.Tate.prod_archDualZeta_eq.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] {n : NumberField.InfinitePlace K → ℤ}
  {t : NumberField.InfinitePlace K → ℂ} {s : ℂ},
  (∀ (v : NumberField.InfinitePlace K), v.IsReal → n v = 0 ∨ n v = 1) →
    (∀ (v : NumberField.InfinitePlace K), 0 < (s + t v).re) →
      (∀ (v : NumberField.InfinitePlace K), (s + t v).re < 1) →
        ∏ v, Langlands.Tate.archDualZeta v (n v) (t v) s =
          (∏ v, Langlands.Tate.archRootNumber v (n v)) *
              (Langlands.gammaFactor K (fun v => if v.IsReal then n v else -n v) (fun v => -t v) (1 - s) /
                Langlands.gammaFactor K n t s) *
            ∏ v, Langlands.Tate.archZeta v (n v) (t v) s

Langlands.Tate.prod_archZeta.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] {n : NumberField.InfinitePlace K → ℤ}
  {t : NumberField.InfinitePlace K → ℂ} {s : ℂ},
  (∀ (v : NumberField.InfinitePlace K), v.IsReal → n v = 0 ∨ n v = 1) →
    (∀ (v : NumberField.InfinitePlace K), 0 < (s + t v).re) →
      ∏ v, Langlands.Tate.archZeta v (n v) (t v) s =
        ↑Real.pi ^ NumberField.InfinitePlace.nrComplexPlaces K * Langlands.gammaFactor K n t s

Langlands.Tate.prod_exp_eq_exp_sum.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] (α : K) (t : NumberField.InfinitePlace K → ℝ),
  ∏ w, ↑(Real.exp (-(Real.pi * ↑w.mult * w α ^ 2 * t w))) = ↑(Real.exp (-Real.pi * ∑ w, ↑w.mult * t w * w α ^ 2))

Langlands.Tate.prod_pi_complex.type:

Langlands.Tate.prod_pow_mult_eq.type:

Langlands.Tate.prod_sqrt_pow_mult.type: ∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] (t : ℝ), ∏ w, √t ^ w.mult = √t ^ Module.finrank ℚ K

Langlands.Tate.prod_sqrt_unitScale.type:

    ∀ (c : Fin (NumberField.Units.rank K) → ℝ),
      ∏ w, √(Langlands.Tate.unitScale K y c w) ^ w.mult = √y ^ Module.finrank ℚ K

Langlands.Tate.realFourier_realTest.type:
∀ {a : ℤ},
  a = 0 ∨ a = 1 →

      Langlands.Tate.realRootNumber a * Langlands.Tate.realTest a y

Langlands.Tate.realTest_mul_archChar.type:
∀ {a : ℤ},
  a = 0 ∨ a = 1 →
    ∀ (t : ℂ) (x : ℝ),
      Langlands.Tate.realTest a x * Langlands.Tate.archChar 1 a t ↑x =
        ↑|x| ^ a.toNat * Complex.exp (-(↑Real.pi * ↑|x| ^ 2)) * ↑|x| ^ t

Langlands.Tate.realZeta_const_mul.type:

Langlands.Tate.realZeta_realFourier_real.type:
∀ {a : ℤ},
  a = 0 ∨ a = 1 →
    ∀ {t s : ℂ},
      (s + t).re < 1 →
        Langlands.Tate.realZeta (Langlands.Tate.realFourier (Langlands.Tate.realTest a)) a (-t) (1 - s) =
          Langlands.Tate.realRootNumber a * (1 - s - t + ↑a).Gammaℝ

Langlands.Tate.realZeta_realTest.type:
∀ {a : ℤ},
  a = 0 ∨ a = 1 →
    ∀ {t s : ℂ}, 0 < (s + t).re → Langlands.Tate.realZeta (Langlands.Tate.realTest a) a t s = (s + t + ↑a).Gammaℝ

Langlands.Tate.real_local_functional_equ.type:
∀ {a : ℤ},
  a = 0 ∨ a = 1 →
    ∀ {t s : ℂ},
      0 < (s + t).re →
        (s + t).re < 1 →
          Langlands.Tate.realZeta (Langlands.Tate.realFourier (Langlands.Tate.realTest a)) a (-t) (1 - s) =
            Langlands.Tate.realRootNumber a * ((1 - s - t + ↑a).Gammaℝ / (s + t + ↑a).Gammaℝ) *
              Langlands.Tate.realZeta (Langlands.Tate.realTest a) a t s

  [inst_3 : IsNonarchimedeanLocalField K] {χ₁ χ₂ : Kˣ →* ℂˣ} {hχ₁ : Langlands.IsSmoothChar K χ₁}
  {hχ₂ : Langlands.IsSmoothChar K χ₂} (f : (Langlands.principalSeriesInd χ₁ χ₂ hχ₁ hχ₂).V)
  (b : ↥(Langlands.GL2.borel K)) (g : GL (Fin 2) K),
  Langlands.SmoothRep.ind.toFun f (↑b * g) =
    (↑(χ₁ (Langlands.GL2.diagFst b)) * ↑(χ₂ (Langlands.GL2.diagSnd b))) • Langlands.SmoothRep.ind.toFun f g
